# VFX UI Anime

> Dependency-free anime-inspired Web Components for expressive interface feedback.

## Project map
- `README.md`: overview and quick start.
- `core.js`: shared canvas and motion engine.
- `components/button.js`: vfx-button.
- `components/toggle.js`: vfx-toggle.
- `components/slider.js`: vfx-slider.
- `components/checkbox.js`: vfx-checkbox.
- `components/radio.js`: vfx-radio with labeled, named, required and disabled group support.
- `components/input.js`: vfx-input.
- `components/tabs.js`: vfx-tabs with horizontal/vertical orientation and arrow/Home/End keyboard navigation.
- `components/progress.js`: vfx-progress.
- `components/rating.js`: vfx-rating.
- `components/toast.js`: vfx-toast.
- `components/tooltip.js`: vfx-tooltip.
- `docs/COMPONENTS.md`: component inventory and concise API overview.
- `docs/COMPONENT_API_REFERENCE.md`: detailed attributes, properties, methods, events, payloads and implementation limitations.
- `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md`: framework integration boundaries and high-level setup notes.
- `docs/INTEGRATION_COOKBOOK.md`: practical vanilla JavaScript, React, Vue and Angular integration patterns, with form and accessibility cautions.
- `examples/basic.html`: minimal button and toggle integration.
- `examples/integration-cookbook.html`: runnable all-component example with host-managed state and event handling.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: runtime architecture.
- `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md`: known accessibility gaps and QA checklist.
- `docs/TESTING.md`: testing scope and current validation limitations.
- `skills/vfx-ui-anime/SKILL.md`: instructions for extending the project.

## Integration rules
1. Load `core.js` before component scripts when particle effects are required.
2. Keep native semantics and keyboard behavior.
3. Use the documented custom element names and events.
4. Check the detailed API reference for exact event payloads and current limitations.
5. Keep application state and associated content in the host application.
6. Do not claim full accessibility or cross-browser support without testing.
7. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
8. Preserve the project's MIT license when redistributing.
